examples: Ephemeral joy.
An ephemeral flower.
The ephemeral beauty.

more.def: Lasting for only a very short time.
examples: The ephemeral flower bloomed for just a day.
Rainbows are ephemeral.
The snowman was an ephemeral work of art.

easy.def: A very long story about heroes.
examples: We read an epic.
The epic is long.
An epic about a hero.

more.def: A very long story or poem about the brave adventures of heroes.
examples: The ancient epic tells of a hero's long trip home from a war.
We listened to a part of the epic every night.
The movie was an epic about explorers who sailed around the world.
It was an epic game.
An epic trip.
An epic adventure.

more.def: Very big, long and exciting, like the adventures in a great story.
examples: Their trip across the country was an epic adventure.
It was an epic battle between the two best teams.
The epic movie was three hours long.

easy.def: The spot on the ground above an earthquake.
examples: The epicenter is on the ground.
Find the epicenter.
The epicenter was near the town.

more.def: The point on the Earth's surface directly above where an earthquake begins.
examples: The epicenter of the earthquake was near the town.
The shaking was strongest at the epicenter.
Scientists found the epicenter.

easy.def: When a sickness spreads to many people.
examples: A flu epidemic hit the town.
The epidemic spread fast.
The epidemic ended.

more.def: A time when a sickness spreads quickly to many people.
examples: A flu epidemic closed the schools for a week.
Doctors worked hard to stop the epidemic.
The epidemic ended when the weather warmed.

easy.def: A short part at the end of a story.
examples: The epilogue is short.
Read the epilogue.
The epilogue told what happened.

more.def: A short section at the end of a book or play that tells what happened afterward.
examples: The epilogue told us what happened to the heroes years later.
She read the epilogue first.
The play ended with a short epilogue.
I watched an episode.
The episode was funny.
This is my favorite episode.

more.def: One show or part of a TV series or book.
examples: We watched a new episode of the show.
The last episode ended with a surprise.
Each episode is thirty minutes long.
She is the epitome of joy.
The epitome of speed.
He is the epitome of calm.

more.def: A perfect example of a quality or type.
examples: She is the epitome of kindness.
The cheetah is the epitome of speed.
He was the epitome of calm.
An epoch is long.
The dinosaur epoch.
It was a new epoch.

more.def: A long period of time in history, marked by important events or changes.
examples: The ice age was an epoch in Earth's history.
The invention of the car began a new epoch.
The epoch lasted thousands of years.
